name: circlestore
description: Schema-driven secondhand marketplace — the sell form is data, not code

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:setup
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run db:init && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
